inputs.text: [excited] Try… SEH… rah… tops. [curious] In Greek, "tri" means three. "Cerat" is horn. And "ops" is face. [pauses] So, what do you think that spells out?
[happily] Exactly. [warmly] He lived in North America, sixty-six million years ago.
[warmly] Yes. [happily] The real Triceratops. He lived alongside Torosaurus and Edmontosaurus — and T. rex was prowling nearby.
